capabilities: Rename the file when its first heading changes
Insert or update the first heading to match the filename on open
Shorten filenames from long headings with an optional byte limit
Run manual sync commands with the automatic hooks disabled
extras: The README warns the plugin is destructive: it overwrites the first heading the moment a file is opened. Regex exclusion rules and disabling the file-open/file-save hooks are offered to resolve conflicts with other plugins.
problem: Obsidian treats filenames and headings as independent, so renaming a file or editing a heading leaves the two out of sync.

relations.evidence: Disable the file-open hook in settings and they should play together nicely

summary: Plugin that keeps the filename and the first heading of a note synchronized in both directions, automatically or via manual commands.
